title: karangolum ebenaceum
intro: Karangolum ebenaceum, commonly known as the "Java Rose," is a medicinal plant species native to Indonesia. It has been traditionally used to treat various health issues, including fever, cough, and skin conditions, due to its numerous health benefits, such as reducing inflammation and acting as an antimicrobial agent. The therapeutic actions of Karangolum ebenaceum include its analgesic, antipyretic, and antiseptic properties, which can help alleviate pain, reduce fever, and prevent the growth of microorganisms. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential uses in traditional medicine.
